- Positive: only LGBTI org operates freely in all ten districts, good relationship with police; police intervened to protect a lesbian in 2015; Pride marches annually since 2013 with police escorts, a few hundred attendees.
- No documented trans-specific provisions on screening, facilities, custody, care — not_documented either way.
- No documented statement about societal tolerance of trans people specifically.
